verdict.rationale: PayPal's own docs cover each step of the story. The ACP path manages checkout sessions per the ACP spec and receives a single-use Braintree delegated payment token through a `complete_checkout` tool. The UCP path delivers a Braintree token in `credential.token` on the `/checkout-session/{id}/complete` call. Store Sync lets agents create carts and complete purchases, with the order landing in the merchant's existing order management system. Access is gated: it requires a Braintree account or a PayPal access request via form, Google enablement for UCP, and Store Sync covers only US physical goods in USD. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of a completed agent purchase, explicit documentation of the order-confirmation response returned to the agent, and broader availability beyond the gated, US-only scope.
